question.problem: Find an expression that's equivalent to $\dfrac{2}3 a.$
question.worked_solution:
Writing $a$ as $\dfrac{a}{1},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3}\,a & =\frac{2}{3}\cdot a \\  & =\frac{2}{3}\cdot \frac{a}{1} \\  & =\frac{2\cdot a}{3\cdot 1} \\  & =\frac{2a}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the expressions $\dfrac{2}{3}a$ and $\dfrac{2a}{3}$ are equivalent.
